meta.title: Builtin Validator Exhaustiveness — Phase 1
meta.prd_src: Approved PRD: builtin.go per-field PodSpec validation
meta.wave_logic: AWUs are ordered by dependency (AWU 1 provides the shared helper that all others consume) and by structural similarity (apps/v1 types share identical PodTemplate.Spec access pattern; batch/v1 types have a nested path; Pod/ReplicaSet are direct-spec access).

awus.title: Add validatePodSpec() shared helper + wire into Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet
awus.description: Add a new `validatePodSpec(podSpec *corev1.PodSpec, path *field.Path) field.ErrorList` function to builtin.go that validates all Phase 1 fields. Wire it into `validateDeployment`, `validateStatefulSet`, and `validateDaemonSet` at their PodTemplate.Spec path. These three share the identical `spec.template.spec` access pattern and compose the bulk of coverage.

tdd_failing_test_case.name: TestBuiltinValidatorDetectsInvalidContainerNameInDeployment
tdd_failing_test_case.scenario: Deployment with container name containing uppercase (violates DNS-1123 label) should fail
tdd_failing_test_case.yaml_snippet:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: test
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: test
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: test
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: Bad_Name
        image: nginx
tdd_failing_test_case.passes_when: validatePodSpec() exists and rejects invalid container names

acceptance_criteria: validatePodSpec() function exists in builtin.go with signature func(*corev1.PodSpec, *field.Path) field.ErrorList
validateDeployment calls validatePodSpec(deploy.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
validateStatefulSet calls validatePodSpec(ss.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
validateDaemonSet calls validatePodSpec(ds.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
Deployment with empty container name returns an error
StatefulSet with duplicate container names returns an error
DaemonSet with invalid container image (empty) returns an error
Existing valid manifests for all three types continue to pass
No existing ObjectMeta validation is removed or changed
No new dependencies added to go.mod

awus.title: Wire validatePodSpec into Pod and ReplicaSet
awus.description: Wire the shared `validatePodSpec` helper into `validatePod` (path: `spec`) and `validateReplicaSet` (path: `spec.template.spec`). Pod has a direct spec; ReplicaSet uses the PodTemplate.Spec pattern.

tdd_failing_test_case.name: TestBuiltinValidatorDetectsInvalidServiceAccountNameInPod
tdd_failing_test_case.scenario: Pod with invalid serviceAccountName (contains underscore) should fail DNS-1123 subdomain validation
tdd_failing_test_case.yaml_snippet:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: test-pod
  namespace: default
spec:
  serviceAccountName: invalid_account
  containers:
  - name: test
    image: busybox
tdd_failing_test_case.passes_when: validatePodSpec() rejects invalid serviceAccountName in Pod

acceptance_criteria: validatePod calls validatePodSpec(pod.Spec, field.NewPath("spec"))
validateReplicaSet calls validatePodSpec(rs.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
Pod with empty container image returns an error
ReplicaSet with invalid container port range returns an error
Existing valid Pod and ReplicaSet manifests continue to pass
Container name uniqueness check applies across both containers and initContainers

awus.title: Wire validatePodSpec into Job and CronJob
awus.description: Wire the shared `validatePodSpec` helper into `validateJob` (path: `spec.template.spec`) and `validateCronJob` (path: `spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.spec`). Probes may be skipped for batch workloads per PRD.

tdd_failing_test_case.name: TestBuiltinValidatorDetectsInvalidContainerImageInJob
tdd_failing_test_case.scenario: Job with empty container image should fail
tdd_failing_test_case.yaml_snippet:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: test-job
  namespace: default
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: job
        image: ""
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
tdd_failing_test_case.passes_when: validatePodSpec() rejects empty image in Job

acceptance_criteria: validateJob calls validatePodSpec(job.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
validateCronJob calls validatePodSpec(cj.Spec.JobTemplate.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "jobTemplate", "spec", "template", "spec"))
Job with duplicate container names returns an error
CronJob with invalid container port returns an error
Existing valid Job and CronJob manifests continue to pass
Probe validation is skipped for batch workloads (probe fields are not validated in batch context)
Volume mount name validation against volume names works for Job/CronJob

awus.title: Wire validatePodSpec into ReplicationController
awus.description: Wire the shared `validatePodSpec` helper into `validateReplicationController` (path: `spec.template.spec`). This is the last consumer of the shared helper in Phase 1.

tdd_failing_test_case.name: TestBuiltinValidatorDetectsMissingVolumeNameInReplicationController
tdd_failing_test_case.scenario: ReplicationController with a volume that has no name should fail
tdd_failing_test_case.yaml_snippet:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ReplicationController
metadata:
  name: test-rc
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    app: test
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: test
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        image: nginx
        volumeMounts:
        - name: myvol
          mountPath: /data
      volumes:
      - name: ""
        emptyDir: {}
tdd_failing_test_case.passes_when: validatePodSpec() rejects empty volume name in ReplicationController

acceptance_criteria: validateReplicationController calls validatePodSpec(rc.Spec.Template.Spec, field.NewPath("spec", "template", "spec"))
ReplicationController with invalid container env name returns an error
ReplicationController with volume mount referencing non-existent volume returns an error
Existing valid ReplicationController manifests continue to pass
All existing ReplicationController validations (replicas, selector) remain intact
